title: 官方头随机初始化冻结对照

protocol.research_question: 官方 ConvPnP 头在冻结特征协议下从随机初始化训练,能否达到 EXP005(官方头从预训练继续微调)的旋转水平(reS 0.5444)?即官方头的旋转优势是预训练继承还是结构可读出?
protocol.single_changed_variable: official ConvPnPNet head trained from random initialization instead of continued from official weights (EXP005), under the EXP013A frozen protocol
protocol.weights_note: MODEL.WEIGHTS points to the pnp-stripped derivative (research/exp013/e_prep.py, pretrained_models/lmo_pbr/model_final_wo_optim_wo_pnp.pth); the official pnp keys share their names with the rebuilt head and would overwrite the random initialization

model.head_flags: official-native: GN+gelu, flatten fc1 8192->1024, denormalize_by_extent, REGION_ATTENTION=True, WITH_2D_COORD=abs, MASK_ATTENTION=none
model.training_renderer: none (frozen geometry supervision disabled; no CPP/EGL renderer is constructed)
model.optimizer: Ranger lr 8e-4 (EXP013 family recipe, matching official full-training lr), warmup 200

acceptance_gate.ar_reS_ge_0.54: 官方头读出结构优势成立;GLM-Pose M2(注意力池化替代 fc1)假设获得强支撑
acceptance_gate.ar_reS_0.52_to_0.54: 部分支撑;M2 与 M3 并重
acceptance_gate.ar_reS_lt_0.52: 官方头优势主要为预训练继承;M2 立论降级,重心移向 M3 与训练制度
acceptance_gate.noise_caveat: EXP013 家族单评估摆幅 ±0.01~0.015,读数结论需结合逐 epoch 轨迹;正式引用前补第二 seed
